		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-34b86bfc e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent" data-id="34b86bfc" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container" id="about" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-591e12cb elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="591e12cb" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">About us</h2>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-3db64ab1 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="3db64ab1" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p data-start="253" data-end="374">Driven by a passion for kiteboarding and a deep appreciation for hospitality, Windtown was created with a clear vision:</p><p data-start="376" data-end="468"><em data-start="376" data-end="433">“A place where people can truly unwind and enjoy life.”</em><br data-start="433" data-end="436" />says Suzette, founder of Windtown</p><p data-start="470" data-end="621">In the early days of kiteboarding, when information was scarce, it took years of travel and teaching across the world to discover the ideal location.</p><p data-start="623" data-end="674">And then it was found: a place unlike any other.</p><p data-start="676" data-end="834">Here, the journey continued with the creation of a boutique hotel, complemented by a kite center, restaurant and spa. All designed with care and intention.</p><p data-start="836" data-end="880"><em>&#8220;The sense of completion was unforgettable.</em></p><p data-start="882" data-end="969"><em>Over time, Windtown has evolved into the refined and welcoming destination it is today.</em></p><p class="cgHgbA pYZEjA Xp24Nw"><em><span class="OYPEnA">The thrill  when it was finished was indescribable.</span></em></p><p class="cgHgbA pYZEjA Xp24Nw"><em><span class="OYPEnA">Over the years, we’ve grown into what it is today.&#8221;</span></em></p>								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-e8106de e-con-full e-flex e-con e-parent" data-id="e8106de" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-108c8dcd e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="108c8dcd" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-57a57563 animated-slow e-con-full e-flex elementor-invisible e-con e-child" data-id="57a57563" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;,&quot;animation&quot;:&quot;fadeInUp&quot;,&quot;animation_delay&quot;:600}">
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-4f19c29f e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="4f19c29f" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-2e66939e elementor-blockquote--skin-quotation elementor-blockquote--align-center elementor-widget elementor-widget-blockquote" data-id="2e66939e" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="blockquote.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
							<blockquote class="elementor-blockquote">
			<p class="elementor-blockquote__content">
				A dream realised on South Africa’s West Coast			</p>
					</blockquote>
						</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-3faf75c2 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="3faf75c2" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p data-start="314" data-end="437">Windtown Lagoon Hotel in Langebaan has become a place where the stillness of nature meets the energy of turquoise waters.</p><p data-start="439" data-end="598">A setting shaped by wind, light and space, equally inspiring for kite surfers and for those simply seeking time to unwind, reconnect and enjoy the outdoors.</p><p data-start="600" data-end="715">At the heart of Windtown lies an appreciation for quality, personal attention and the quiet beauty of simplicity.</p><p data-start="717" data-end="865">These values are reflected throughout: in the clean, understated design, and in an atmosphere that feels both refined and effortlessly welcoming.</p><p data-start="867" data-end="918">Staying at Windtown is designed to feel personal.</p><p data-start="920" data-end="1048">Stories are shared, local knowledge is passed on, and a genuine connection to this remarkable place is part of the experience.</p><p data-start="1050" data-end="1140">Thoughtfully prepared food, comfortable rooms and ever-changing views complete the stay.</p><p data-start="1142" data-end="1216">Langebaan is a place to be experienced; pure, vibrant and full of life.</p>								</div>
				</div>
				</div>
				</div>
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-dc1ba40 e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent" data-id="dc1ba40" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-2ff6a017 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="2ff6a017" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">About Langebaan</h2>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-57655b5f elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="57655b5f" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p data-start="103" data-end="144"><strong data-start="103" data-end="144">Langebaan: South Africa’s coastal gem</strong></p><p data-start="255" data-end="359">Just an hour from Cape Town, Langebaan is a place where unspoiled nature meets a calm, coastal rhythm.</p><p data-start="361" data-end="563">Defined by its turquoise lagoon, steady winds and open landscapes, it has become a sought-after destination for kite and wing enthusiasts, as well as for those drawn to space, light and tranquillity.</p><p data-start="565" data-end="840">Beyond the water, the surrounding area offers a rich natural landscape. The West Coast National Park invites exploration, whether by foot, kayak or simply through quiet observation. Encounters with wildlife, birdlife and expansive views are part of the everyday experience.</p><p data-start="842" data-end="949">From Windtown, nature is always close, with walking trails and wide, peaceful beaches just moments away.</p><p data-start="951" data-end="1080">A favourite vantage point is the Seeberg Lookout, where the shifting colours of the lagoon are best appreciated towards sunset.</p><p data-start="1082" data-end="1212">In town, a relaxed atmosphere is reflected in a selection of cafés, waterfront restaurants, small galleries and local boutiques.</p><p data-start="1214" data-end="1344">Whether drawn by the wind or the stillness, Langebaan offers a rare sense of balance: refined, natural and quietly captivating.</p>								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
				</div>
